- Overall performance: The company's revenue after eliminations is 1699.76 billion INR with a gross margin of 44.9% and EBITDA margin of 24.9%.
- The company that contributes the most to the revenue is Wipro Consumer Care International with 517.76 billion INR, and the one that needs attention is Wipro Kawasaki Precision Machinery with the lowest EBITDA margin of 14%.
- Margins: The company has a gross margin of 44.9% and an EBITDA margin of 24.9%, with Wipro Infrastructure Engineering having the highest gross margin at 56% and Wipro Consumer Care International having the highest EBITDA margin at 34.2%.
- Working capital: As of 2025-12-01, the working capital days are represented by DSO of 107 days and DPO of 284 days, indicating a need for improvement in managing working capital.
- Top 3 revenue drivers: The top drivers are everything excluding business Joint Ventures with a revenue change of 62.01 billion INR (85.2% of total change), SAP product sales with a revenue change of 57.64 billion INR (79.2% of total change), and business Joint Ventures with a revenue change of 10.76 billion INR (14.8% of total change).
